profile.headline: Software Systems specialist
profile.summary:
With a robust background in web design and development, my freelance career focuses on creating dynamic and user-friendly web applications. My expertise in JAVA and a keen eye for aesthetic design drive the development of websites that are not only functional but also visually appealing, catering to diverse client needs.

During my time as a Student Trainee Engineer with the US Navy, I honed skills in software development and technical support. This experience, coupled with my hands-on approach, allows me to tackle complex technical challenges with innovative solutions, consistently aiming to enhance user experiences and system efficiency.
